{{Quote|The Emperor didn't mint enough of those guys to keep me from rescuing Mirax. They can run or they can die, their choice.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="IJ" />}}
The '''Battle of Susevfi''' was a battle during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] against both the [[Invids]] and [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] on [[Susevfi]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] in order to rescue [[Mirax Terrik Horn]].

==Prelude==
In order to track down his [[Mirax Terrik Horn|wife]] kidnapped by former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] infiltrated one of Tavira's [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], the [[Khuiumin Survivors]], as [[Jenos Idanian]]. He then [[Mission to Courkrus|haunted]] the [[Invids]] on [[Courkrus]], disguising himself as a Jedi Knight. Tavira dispatched five [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] to apprehend Horn. They were quickly defeated, particularly thanks to the arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The Jedi learnt from the Jensaarai that Tavira's base was on [[Susevfi]].

==Infiltration on Susevfi==
{{Quote|You can't stop her.|A captured female Jensaarai, about [[Leonia Tavira]]|<ref name="IJ" />}}
[[File:CorranHorn3.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], disguised as [[Keiran Halcyon]].]]

Horn, Skywalker, [[Ooryl Qrygg]] and [[Elegos A'Kla]] departed for Susevfi after entrusting [[Jacob Nive]], the leader of the Khuiumin Survivors, with the secret of Horn's identity and offering him a pardon and a chance for the Survivors to start over, if they kept the captured Jensaarai guarded with an [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]]. The other ysalamir kept the Jensaarai from sensing the Jedi's presence when they landed on Susevfi.

On landing, the four proceeded to the [[Governor/Legends|governor's]] [[Leonia Tavira's palace|palace]], where they knew Mirax was being held. They attacked it, powering through the stormtrooper guards, and Horn was able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to locate Mirax's cell. Skywalker pulled her out of the Force-induced trance she had been put in, and Horn was overjoyed to be reunited with his wife.

==Duel the Jensaarai==
[[File:Jensaarai.jpg|thumb|right|The Jensaarai ''[[Saarai-kaar]]'']]

As there were too many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] alerted for them to fight their way back to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the group decided to fight their way up the tallest tower of the palace to the landing pad and try to find a ship to flee in. Tavira fled from the top of the tower, but on their way up, Horn's group encountered the Jensaarai, led by their [[Saarai-kaar]]. The Saarai-kaar seemed convinced that she was meant to confront Horn, and the two dueled. Horn's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] failed on contact with her [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] armor, and as she stood over him, he projected into her head the image of [[Nikkos Tyris]], the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] whom he had seen kill his grandfather in his earlier dream and whose distinctive lightsaber style the Saarai-kaar shared. Mirax was able to stun her, and with Skywalker having defeated the other Jensaarai, the last threat remaining was Tavira.

==Space battle==
{{Dialogue|Corran Horn|New Republic will be here in no time. The days of the ''Invidious'' are over.|Leonia Tavira|Never!|Corran Horn|By the way, the month's not up, but the answer is no.|Leonia Tavira|Arrgghhh! When I get my hands on you&hellip;|Mirax Terrik Horn|In your dreams, deary. Empire's been dead for years, and still she relies on those limping Imperial threats. "When I get my hands on you!" Get with the times, woman&hellip;|attr=Tavira's hologram confronts Corran and Mirax Horn|src=<ref name="IJ" />}}

[[File:Tavira1.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Leonia Tavira]].]]

Having lost control of the situation on the moon, Tavira fled in a shuttle before her enemies could reach her and returned to the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Invidious]]'', intending to use it to destroy the palace in order to prevent Horn's escape. However, the Star Destroyer was intercepted by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], the Khuiumin Survivors and Mirax's father, [[Booster Terrik]], aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]''. As the two sides fought in orbit, Horn used a powerful [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to frighten Tavira into believing that a large [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet, including the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and the recently destroyed [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Sun Crusher]], was arriving in the vicinity. Believing that the Jedi had lured her into a trap, Tavira fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We are not evil.''"<br />"''No, the Jensaarai are not, nor are they wholly good.|The [[Unidentified female Saarai-kaar|Saarai-kaar]] and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="IJ" />}}
The ''Errant Venture'', Rogue Squadron, and the Survivors helped secure Susevfi and an agreement was reached that allowed the Survivors to become the word's security force. Horn and the others confronted the gathered Jensaarai prisoners and learned their history. They realized they had not learned enough of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ways to become devotees of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and believed themselves to be heirs to the true Jedi tradition. Horn and Skywalker were able to get through to the Saarai-kaar and convince her that the Jensaarai were not wholly correct in their outlook on the Force and invited them to join the [[New Jedi Order]].
